## 2.4 R 基础

使用课程项目与共用路径工具。

```{r tools}
helper <- c("tutorial-tools.R", "../tutorial-tools.R")
source(helper[file.exists(helper)][1])
gis_packages(c("tidyverse", "sf", "janitor", "tmap"))
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
root <- gis_root()
```

## 计算与赋值

运算遵循优先级；赋值保存当前结果，修改输入不会自动重算已有对象。

```{r basics}
getwd()
1 + 5
4 * 5^2
A <- 1
B <- 2
C <- A + B
C
ls()
rm(A)
```

## 向量、表格与索引

`[行, 列]` 取子集；`$` 和 `[[ ]]` 取列向量。`rnorm()` 的结果随运行变化。

```{r plots-and-data-frames}
Data1 <- c(1:100)
Data2 <- c(101:200)
plot(Data1, Data2, col = "red")
Data3 <- rnorm(100, mean = 53, sd = 34)
Data4 <- rnorm(100, mean = 64, sd = 14)
plot(Data3, Data4, col = "blue")
df <- data.frame(Data1, Data2)
plot(df, col = "green")
head(df)
tail(df)
df[1:10, 1]
df[5:15, ]
df[c(2, 3, 6), 2]
df[, 1]
df <- dplyr::rename(df, column1 = Data1, column2 = Data2)
dplyr::select(df, column1)
df$column1
df[["column1"]]
```

## 2.5 数据读取与类型

Ward Profiles 使用 latin1；`problems()` 检查解析，NA 保持缺失含义。教材的 Excel 分支是在副本中清除 `#VALUE!`、`n/a` 后保存 CSV，主线采用下方 R 导入。

```{r read-and-inspect}
ward_file <- gis_file("data/raw/london/attributes/ward-profiles-excel-version.csv")
LondonData <- readr::read_csv(ward_file, locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                              na = c("", "NA", "n/a"), show_col_types = FALSE)
type_table <- tibble(variable = names(LondonData),
                     type = vapply(LondonData, function(x) paste(class(x), collapse = "/"), character(1)))
type_table
readr::problems(LondonData)
names(LondonData)
summary(LondonData)
```

## 筛选与寿命指标

按 E09 地区代码筛选 borough，只去整行完全重复记录。男女寿命简单平均后与历史基准 81.16 年比较；不是人口加权指标。

```{r select-and-clean}
LondonBoroughs <- LondonData %>%
  filter(stringr::str_detect(`New code`, "^E09")) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Borough = `Ward name`) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()
gis_unique(LondonBoroughs, "new_code")
LondonBoroughs %>% dplyr::select(contains("expectancy"), borough)
Life_expectancy <- LondonBoroughs %>%
  mutate(averagelifeexpectancy = (female_life_expectancy_2009_13 + male_life_expectancy_2009_13) / 2,
         normalisedlifeexpectancy = averagelifeexpectancy / mean(averagelifeexpectancy, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(new_code, borough, averagelifeexpectancy, normalisedlifeexpectancy) %>%
  arrange(desc(normalisedlifeexpectancy))
slice_head(Life_expectancy, n = 5)
slice_tail(Life_expectancy, n = 5)
Life_expectancy2 <- Life_expectancy %>%
  mutate(UKdiff = averagelifeexpectancy - 81.16,
         UKcompare = case_when(is.na(UKdiff) ~ NA_character_,
                               UKdiff > 0 ~ "above UK average", TRUE ~ "at or below UK average"))
Life_expectancy2 %>% group_by(UKcompare) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), range = max(UKdiff) - min(UKdiff), mean = mean(UKdiff), .groups = "drop")
Life_expectancy3 <- Life_expectancy2 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)),
         UKdiff_rounded = round(UKdiff, 0)) %>%
  count(UKcompare, UKdiff_rounded)
Life_expectancy3
Life_expectancy4 <- Life_expectancy2
```

## 属性散点图

横轴为男性预期寿命，纵轴为儿童肥胖率；图形描述关联。

```{r scatter}
plot(LondonBoroughs$male_life_expectancy_2009_13,
     LondonBoroughs$percent_children_in_reception_year_who_are_obese_2011_12_to_2013_14)
```

## 边界与属性连接

代码键保持一地区一行；`left_join` 保留伦敦边界，`inner_join` 保留两侧匹配地区。

```{r boundary-and-joins}
EW <- st_read(gis_file("data/raw/london/boundaries/lad_dec_2015_gb_bfc/LAD_Dec_2015_FCB_GB.shp"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()
LondonMap <- EW %>% filter(str_detect(lad15cd, "^E09"))
gis_unique(LondonMap, "lad15cd")

dplyr::anti_join(st_drop_geometry(LondonMap), LondonBoroughs, by = c("lad15cd" = "new_code"))
BoroughDataMap <- left_join(LondonMap, LondonBoroughs,
                            by = c("lad15cd" = "new_code"), relationship = "one-to-one")
Life_expectancy4map <- inner_join(EW, Life_expectancy4,
                                 by = c("lad15cd" = "new_code"), relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(BoroughDataMap) == nrow(LondonMap))
```

## JSA 静态地图

JSA 字段是领取率；与数量区分。

```{r static-jsa}
tmap_mode("plot")
jsa <- "rate_of_job_seekers_allowance_jsa_claimants_2015"
gis_columns(BoroughDataMap, jsa)
jsa_map <- tm_shape(BoroughDataMap) +
  tm_polygons(fill = jsa, fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(style = "jenks", values = "brewer.bu_pu")) +
  tm_title("Job seekers' allowance claimants") + tm_compass() + tm_scalebar()
jsa_map
```

## 栅格底图分支

需要网络、OpenStreetMap 包及相应 Java 依赖；失败时可使用下一块交互底图。

```{r optional-original-raster-basemap, eval=FALSE}
gis_packages("tmaptools")
tmaplondon <- tmaptools::read_osm(st_bbox(BoroughDataMap), type = "esri", zoom = NULL)
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(tmaplondon) + tm_rgb() +
  tm_shape(BoroughDataMap) +
  tm_polygons(fill = jsa, fill_alpha = 0.5,
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(style = "jenks", values = "brewer.bu_pu")) +
  tm_compass() + tm_scalebar() + tm_title("Job seekers' allowance claimants")
```

## 交互地图

转为 EPSG:4326，并叠加 OpenStreetMap 在线底图。

```{r interactive-jsa}
tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(st_transform(BoroughDataMap, 4326)) +
  tm_polygons(fill = jsa, fill_alpha = 0.5) + tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap")
```

## 寿命差值图

`UKdiff` 单位为寿命年数差，正值高于教材基准。

```{r life-difference-map}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(Life_expectancy4map) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "UKdiff", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(values = "brewer.rd_bu")) +
  tm_title("Life expectancy difference from tutorial UK baseline")
```

## 2.6 长宽表转换

使用 `fly-tipping-long.csv`，不使用第一周中文透视宽表。数值含千位逗号和 `:` 缺失占位；`fly_parsing_problems` 在整理前保存。长表一行是地区×年度×指标，八种指标不互相混称。

```{r tidy-long-wide}
fly_file <- gis_file("data/raw/london/attributes/fly-tipping-long.csv")
measures <- c("total_incidents", "total_action_taken", "warning_letters", "fixed_penalty_notices",
              "statutory_notices", "formal_cautions", "injunctions", "prosecutions")
fly_types <- readr::cols(code = col_character(), area = col_character(), year = col_character(),
  total_incidents = col_number(), total_action_taken = col_number(), warning_letters = col_number(),
  fixed_penalty_notices = col_number(), statutory_notices = col_number(), formal_cautions = col_number(),
  injunctions = col_number(), prosecutions = col_number())
flytipping <- read_csv(fly_file, col_types = fly_types)
fly_parsing_problems <- readr::problems(flytipping)
fly_parsing_problems
names(flytipping)
gis_columns(flytipping, c("code", "area", "year", measures))
flytipping <- flytipping %>% mutate(year = as.character(year))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(flytipping[c("code", "year")]))
flytipping_long <- flytipping %>% pivot_longer(all_of(measures), names_to = "tipping_type", values_to = "count")
flytipping_wide <- flytipping_long %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(code, area), names_from = c(year, tipping_type), names_sep = "_", values_from = count)
widefly <- flytipping %>% dplyr::select(code, area, year, total_incidents) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = total_incidents)
stopifnot(nrow(flytipping_long) == nrow(flytipping) * length(measures))
head(flytipping_long)
head(flytipping_wide)
```
